speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and tell me if it involves your feet as well? Also, when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any family members with similar skin symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your nail color or thickness? I also need to know if you have experienced any weight loss or night sweats.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of diabetes, and have you noticed any hair loss on the back of your hands or wrists? I would also like to know if you have experienced any recent exposure to iodine-containing products or medications.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy
The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow/eyelash loss, and palm numbness strongly suggests Hansen's disease (Leprosy). I need to confirm the presence of acid-fast bacilli to finalize the diagnosis.
